args.question: What is the cardholder statement on this transaction?

args.reason: Fraud claim with no AVS/CVV or device evidence to rebut it.

args.explanation: 10.5 fraud chargeback; cardholder said they did not make the purchase. The merchant had only a receipt and authorisation record, none of the required AVS/CVV or device/IP evidence, so I accepted the chargeback at the first stage. Cost is the USD 40.16 sale plus the USD 15 chargeback fee.
